Overview of Saint Gallen Region (Saint Gallen)

Saint Gallen Region (Saint Gallen) is located in the Saint Gallen region of Switzerland, with its prefectural capital at St. Gallen. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Historic Altstadt / Old Town, Panoramic mountain & lake views, Marked SwitzerlandMobility hiking trails, Local heritage museum.

RegionSaint Gallen
Capital citySt. Gallen
Cities & municipalities53
Primary transport hubSt. Gallen Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)

How to get to Saint Gallen Region

Connected via hourly SBB CFF FFS rail and PostBus services; fully covered by the Swiss Travel Pass. Use our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Saint Gallen

When visiting cities across Saint Gallen, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Cheese fondue
  • Raclette
  • Rösti
  • Bircher muesli
  • Swiss artisanal chocolate

Best time to visit Saint Gallen

Best time to visit Saint Gallen: Jun–Sep (summer trails), Dec–Mar (winter sports).
